milestone_spec.label: Anchor Causal
milestone_spec.description: Anchor causal kernel with delayed rescale, anchored waits, and L2-friendly persistent ordering.
milestone_spec.notes: Requires dedicated anchor-aware probes because wait semantics differ from plain wait_wgmma.

anchor_causal_steady_state_regions.label: Anchor causal steady-state region cycles
anchor_causal_steady_state_regions.description: Anchor-aware clock probe for delayed rescale and wait_wgmma_anchor<1/0>.
anchor_causal_steady_state_regions.notes: Measures WG1 steady-state with anchor-specific wait placement; delayed rescale is outside the measured region table.

anchor_causal_scheduler_split.label: Anchor causal scheduler split
anchor_causal_scheduler_split.description: Split probe for named-barrier handoff cost in the anchor kernel.
anchor_causal_scheduler_split.notes: Reports barrier_wait(k_full), named-barrier scheduler sync, and zero explicit clear(acc_s) front-end cost.

anchor_causal_tail_split.label: Anchor causal tail split
anchor_causal_tail_split.description: Split probe for the post-wait<0> tail in the anchor kernel: v_empty handoff, delayed rescale, and acc_s cast copy.
anchor_causal_tail_split.notes: Measures WG1 steady-state tail after wait_wgmma_anchor<0> without perturbing the main steady-state region probe.

anchor_causal_core_split.label: Anchor causal detailed core split
anchor_causal_core_split.description: Detailed anchor WG1 steady-state core split with explicit QK issue, wait(v_full), PV issue, post-wait<1> preamble, softmax core, and wait<0> fence.
anchor_causal_core_split.notes: Uses rescale_before_pv=0 to make the delayed-rescale design visible without mixing it back into the core window.

anchor_causal_total_cycle.label: Anchor causal steady-state total cycle
anchor_causal_total_cycle.description: Directly measured WG1 steady-state total cycle count for anchor causal.
anchor_causal_total_cycle.notes: Measures from pre-k_full wait to post-delayed-rescale tail for n_idx > 0.
